ops.body: 2026-10-14: landed without a Python getter. cc-transcript #57 (merge 31e86f0, released as 14.43.0) stamps a build identity into the core at compile time (`rust/crates/core/build.rs` -> `BUILD_IDENTITY`) and the store binds it into `FactOrigin.engine`, so no host hashes a file. Root reviewed the exact head and asked for no `_native` export. Consumer side is captain-hook PR 366 (head 79c3dfaf): pin 14.43.0, `fact_producer` and the file hash removed, reuse on again. Open until 366 merges.
